scope: Current V3-C dataset, not a new full-scale run. Read-only Exasol view execution vs equivalent DuckDB checks on CSV-loaded tables; includes client execution/fetch, excludes Exasol ingestion. Three sequential warm-capable repeats; no cold-cache claim.

stock_rollforward.exasol_sql: SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(ABS(GAP)) FROM GST_EVIDENCE.V_FEATURES WHERE CHECK_FAMILY='stock_rollforward' AND SEVERITY>0.05
stock_rollforward.duckdb_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT *, LAG(closing_stock) OVER(PARTITION BY factory_id ORDER BY period_month) previous_closing FROM factory_month), f AS (SELECT opening_stock+purchases_finished+declared_output-declared_dispatch-closing_stock gap, GREATEST(ABS(opening_stock+purchases_finished+declared_output-declared_dispatch-closing_stock)-ABS(raw_stock_change),ABS(opening_stock-COALESCE(previous_closing,opening_stock))-ABS(raw_stock_change),0)/NULLIF(declared_output,0) severity FROM m) SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(ABS(gap)) FROM f WHERE severity>0.05

supplier_chain.exasol_sql: SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(ABS(GAP)) FROM GST_EVIDENCE.V_FEATURES WHERE CHECK_FAMILY='supplier_chain' AND SEVERITY>0.05
supplier_chain.duckdb_sql: WITH p AS (SELECT buyer_factory_id,period_month,SUM(quantity) qty FROM purchase_invoices GROUP BY buyer_factory_id,period_month), f AS (SELECT p.qty-COALESCE(r.declared_sales_kg,0) gap, ABS(p.qty-COALESCE(r.declared_sales_kg,0))/NULLIF(p.qty,0) severity FROM p JOIN suppliers s ON s.owner_factory_id=p.buyer_factory_id LEFT JOIN supplier_returns r ON r.supplier_id=s.supplier_id AND r.period_month=p.period_month) SELECT COUNT(*),SUM(ABS(gap)) FROM f WHERE severity>0.05
